operational_failures.failed_witness: The first x2 build stopped because the official quick validator inherited Windows cp1252 and could not decode UTF-8 Māori boundary text in all twenty skill files.
operational_failures.recovery: Reran only the exact validator dependency with PYTHONUTF8=1, then rebuilt the bounded evidence once.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Set explicit UTF-8 for every external skill-creator validation subprocess on Windows.

operational_failures.failed_witness: The first grouped evidence-validation wrapper returned four passing test dots at its output boundary without exposing the continuing session handle.
operational_failures.recovery: Audited process quiescence and staged receipts, retained the four attributable passes, then ran only the unresolved manifest check and not-yet-attributable remainder.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Always serialize the exec result when a validation command may outlive its initial yield.

operational_failures.failed_witness: The first combined Method Flow patch failed its context check because generated JSON key order differed from source object order.
operational_failures.recovery: Split source and generated-ledger edits and anchored the ledger patch to its exact serialized order.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect generated JSON serialization before applying a multi-file exact-context patch.

operational_failures.failed_witness: The first skill-receipt test compared a normalized-text digest with raw checkout bytes and failed one of seven selected checks.
operational_failures.recovery: Changed only that assertion to hash UTF-8 text after universal newline normalization, matching the receipt domain.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Name and compare the same byte or normalized-text domain on both sides of every digest assertion.
